validated_envelope.evidence: Chang 1986 measured patches: within 4.0 % up to h/lambda_d 0.11 (1.8 % with the coax probe); above it NobuRF reads high with a lumped feed, +7.1 % at 0.125 and +10 to +16 % from 0.134 to 0.23 (docs/validation.md section 7.4)

frequency-dependent and magnetic materials match the closed-form slab reflection and transmission coefficients within 6e-3, most within 2e-3 (docs/validation.md section 2.4), but no measured board or ferrite part has checked them yet
the measured resonances that agree lie between 2.31 GHz (Chang 1986) and 7.5 GHz (Sheen 1990 patch): docs/validation.md section 7

the measured benchmarks that agree are one-port patches with a lumped feed; the Sheen 1990 four-port branch-line coupler reads 7 to 9 % low, and the SMA edge launch and coax probe are checked against openEMS only (docs/validation.md sections 3.2, 7)
copper loss matches the Pozar 6.3 cavity wall Q within 0.3 %, but has no measured strip-loss benchmark yet (docs/validation.md sections 7.2, 7.3)
every benchmark has axis-aligned copper; slanted or curved edges are staircased on the grid, which the mesh band measures but no benchmark has checked

warnings: mesh: 1 copper edge(s) along y keep their drawn line, so the grid acts about 0.35 edge cell wider there and lines through them read Z0 low (a first-order error that refining shrinks only slowly): y = -10.2 mm (another line (-10 mm) is within 1.5 edge cells outside it or half an edge cell inside)

mesh: smallest cell 0.200 mm is below edge_cell (0.25 mm) and sets the time step; look for copper edges, the port or layer interfaces closer together than edge_cell. Copper edge lines sit about a third of edge_cell inside the drawn edge, so gaps between lines are rarely whole cells and the grading may shrink cells near them

outside the validated range: eps_r of "core" is 4.4 (validated: 2.2 to 2.33), so the model is unproven against measurement here. measured benchmarks that agree: eps_r 2.2 (Sheen 1990 patch, -0.3 %) and 2.33 (Chang 1986 patches, -0.5 to +1.9 % on the three in section 7.1, -1.8 to +4.0 % on all six up to h/lambda_d 0.11).
